compat.title: 브라우저가 지원되지 않음
compat.message: 귀하의 브라우저는 오디오 녹음을 지원하지 않습니다. 최신 버전의 Chrome, Firefox, Edge 또는 Safari 18.4+를 사용하세요.

micDevices.denied: 마이크 액세스가 거부되었습니다. 브라우저 설정에서 마이크 액세스를 허용해 주세요.
micDevices.notFound: 마이크를 찾을 수 없습니다. 마이크를 연결하고 다시 시도해 주세요.

recorder.displayDenied: Screen or tab sharing was cancelled or denied. Choose the meeting source and enable audio sharing.
recorder.noDisplayAudio: No shared audio was detected. Chrome or Edge tab audio works reliably; full-screen, native-app, and system audio depend on your browser and operating system.
recorder.audioContextSuspended: Audio capture could not start. Click Start Recording again and keep the browser tab active.
recorder.captureEndedBeforeStart: The shared meeting source stopped before recording began. Select it again and retry.

recover.descriptionSingle: 이전 녹음이 중단되었습니다. 저장된 오디오를 복구하시겠습니까?
recover.descriptionMulti: {{n}} 중단된 녹음이 있습니다. 각 세션을 복구하거나 삭제합니다.

exit.title: Recording in progress
exit.description: Leaving this page stops the recording. Choose what to do with the audio captured so far — leaving without choosing would strand the recording on the server.

dataLoss.savePartialDescription: Audio that never reached the server will be permanently lost. The recording will be saved with only the part that was uploaded.
dataLoss.discardDescription: The recording and every chunk already uploaded will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

meetingConsent.title: Record meeting audio?
meetingConsent.description: Make sure everyone has been informed and you are allowed to record. The browser may capture all audio from the source you choose, including unrelated voices or notifications.

activeTakeover.title: Active recording found
activeTakeover.description: A recording session is still marked active. It may still be recording in another tab or window, or it may be left over from a tab that was closed or crashed.
activeTakeover.warning: Taking over interrupts that session. If it is still recording elsewhere, that recording stops and only the audio already uploaded can be recovered.

controls.minDurationHint: Record for at least {{seconds}} seconds before stopping

completing.title: 녹음을 마무리하는 중...
completing.uploadFailedBody: The remaining audio could not be uploaded (error {{status}}), so {{n}} segment(s) are stuck. Retry, or continue with the audio already uploaded.
completing.localWriteWarning: Some audio could not be stored on this device, so the end of this recording may be missing.

toast.uploadInterrupted: 업로드가 중단되었습니다. 녹화가 일시 중지되었습니다. 연결을 확인하세요.
toast.completeFailed: 녹음을 완료하지 못했습니다. 귀하의 오디오가 저장되었습니다.
toast.captureEnded: The shared audio source stopped. Voxis is saving the recording.
toast.captureInterrupted: {{error}} Your saved audio is ready to recover.
toast.captureRecoveryFailed: Recording stopped. Reconnect, then try again to recover the saved audio.
toast.chunkWriteFailed: This device could not store the latest audio. Recording stopped to protect what has already been captured.
toast.trailingAudioMissing: Some audio could not be stored on this device, so the end of this recording may be missing.
toast.meetingWithoutMicrophone: Meeting audio will continue without your microphone.
toast.meetingAudioMuted: Shared meeting audio was muted. Check the browser sharing indicator.
toast.microphoneMuted: Microphone audio was muted. Check your device.
toast.recoveredAfterOffline: Your connection interrupted the recording. The saved audio is processing now.
toast.activeSessionExists: Another recording session is already active. Recover or discard it before starting a new one.
toast.recoverPartialUpload: {{n}} locally saved segment(s) could not be attached. Recovering with the audio the server already has.
toast.releasedActiveSession: A recording session was left open. You can recover or discard it now.
toast.takeOverFailed: Could not take over the recording session. Please try again.

captureSource.label: Capture source
captureSource.mixedHelp: Chrome and Edge can share tab audio. Full-screen, native-app, and system audio depend on your browser and operating system.
captureSource.mixedUnsupported: This browser cannot open a sharing picker. Use Chrome or Edge to share tab audio.
